scope: Static document materialization and ordinary file-byte inspection only. No native platform probes, project imports/functions, tests, recorder, matrix, elevation, code changes or attempt consumption.

source_inventory.limitation: Includes the three existing publisher and five recorder modules as source evidence. Guarded imports are listed without execution. No claim about actual loaded dependency closure, package initialization or a missing external launcher.

runtime_candidate.method: Read fixed file bytes, hash them and parse DOS/PE header fields without loading any candidate DLL, importing ctypes or constructing a native structure. Header version is not a process observation.
runtime_candidate.limitation: Selected files are not the full runtime dependency inventory. PE fields do not establish actual structure offsets, loaded module identities or a future process ABI.

descriptor.name_rule: Exact prebound canonical absolute target, no NUL or terminator, nonempty even byte length <= 0xffffffff
descriptor.tail_rule: No transmitted tail or partial decoding

path_binding.limitation: Canonical lexical path spellings and ordinary existence only. No File-ID, volume identity, filesystem type, link-free status, rights, durability or native absence check is asserted. No directory or reservation created.

actor_role_plan.limitation: These names bind intended distinct roles only; no actor was started or independently admitted. They do not identify an implemented trusted launcher.

operational_budgets.basis: S2-EU recorder.limits and S2-EZ control limits require derivation from the complete concrete source/path inventory. Fixture counts are not replacement call/byte ceilings.

required_before_run: Source-bound once-only entrypoint including abort before durable reservation and restart handling
Source-bound independent observer of worker/supervisor/control-spool completion
Admission of exact complete binding, followed by separate execution authorization
independent_start_and_completion.limitation: No signed assertion, fictional actor, consumed marker or successful completion record is manufactured. Static instructions cannot replace missing executable infrastructure.

fc_static_recheck.reason: Prerequisites have not been fully provided; only this new partial package is statically checked. No passing FC result or execution permission follows.

blockers.change: Existing source hashes, fixed lexical paths, payloads, faults and logical actor names now materialized.
blockers.remaining: F, complete SourceManifest/RunBinding, runtime read closure, derived numeric call/byte limits and independent review remain unbound.

blockers.change: Selected interpreter/dependency file hashes and header evidence now present.
blockers.remaining: Actual native layout origin, full admitted runtime identity, native parent/volume identities and establishment/durability evidence remain absent. Intended ledger directory is absent.

blockers.change: Independent start/completion requirements tied to existing contracts and source inventory.
blockers.remaining: No independent launcher/observer implementation or admitted external context. No actual start or completion is required or claimed in this static step.

next_required_decision: Static-only authorization cannot supply actual native observations or an absent launcher. Separately authorize narrowly scoped read-only ABI/parent metadata collection and, if absent parents are to be used, their explicitly bounded establishment; missing private launcher/observer requires separate implementation authorization. Neither step authorizes the 13-case recorder or matrix. Repeat full S2-FC only after complete prerequisites exist.
